(implementation 0x374ABb8cE19A73f2c4EFAd642bda76c797f19233, active on mainnet from block
13322798 to block 13382884). Source: compound-finance/compound-protocol, commit

* `distributeSupplierComp` (lines 1205 to 1236) and `distributeBorrowerComp` (lines 1244 to 1275).
* `claimComp(holders, cTokens, true, true)` (lines 1320 to 1341) for one holder and one market,
  and `grantCompInternal` (lines 1350 to 1358).
* `setCompSpeedInternal` (lines 1130 to 1156).

account's borrow units. A `sub_` underflow or a `require` failure is `none`.

namespace CompRewards

/-- `fraction(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): `Double(div_(mul_(a, doubleScale), b))`. -/
def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

/-- `mul_(uint a, Double b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): `a * b.mantissa / doubleScale`. -/
def mulDouble (a mantissa : Nat) : Nat := a * mantissa / doubleScale

/-- `sub_(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): reverts on underflow. -/
def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

/-- `updateCompSupplyIndex(cToken)`. -/
def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

/-- `updateCompBorrowIndex(cToken, marketBorrowIndex)`. -/
def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

/-- `distributeSupplierComp(cToken, supplier)`. -/
def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex
  match subChecked supplyIndex supplierIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

/-- `distributeBorrowerComp(cToken, borrower, marketBorrowIndex)`. -/
def distributeBorrowerComp (s : St) (borrower : Account) : Option St :=
  let borrowIndex := s.borrowState.index
  let borrowerIndex :=
    if (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ borrowIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex
  match subChecked borrowIndex borrowerIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let borrowerDelta := mulDouble (s.acct borrower)

result:
/-!
# COMP reward distribution specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the reward flywheel of Compound's Comptroller: the supply and
borrow reward indices of a market, the index recorded for each account, the COMP accrued to
each account, claims, and the one-time upgrade that Compound Proposal 62 ran on mainnet
(`_upgradeSplitCompRewards`, block 13322798, 2021-09-29). Candidates may not edit this file.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `comptroller : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`CompRewards/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole
`CompRewards.comptroller`.

Model, as a reader of `contracts/Comptroller.sol` would map it:

* One market. Its supply side and borrow side each have a reward index (`compSupplyState`,
  `compBorrowState`: `index` and `block`) and a speed in COMP per block (`compSupplySpeeds`,
  `compBorrowSpeeds`). Indices are mantissas at scale 1e36 (`doubleScale`).
* An account holds `supply` cTokens (`CToken.balanceOf`) and `borrow` borrow units (Compound's
  `borrowBalanceStored / borrowIndex`). The market's totals are the sums over all accounts.
* `supplierIndex` and `borrowerIndex` are `compSupplierIndex` and `compBorrowerIndex`; 0 means
  the Comptroller has no index recorded for the account. `accrued` is `compAccrued`, `wallet`
  is the COMP the account holds, and `reserve` is the COMP held by the Comptroller.
* Amounts are natural numbers in the smallest unit (1e-18 COMP); arithmetic is unbounded, so
  the 224-bit and 32-bit overflow checks never fail. A call that reverts is `none`.

The implementation handles the Comptroller's calls: the policy hooks a cToken calls before it
changes a balance (`mintAllowed`, `redeemAllowed`, `transferAllowed`, `seizeAllowed` on the
supply side; `borrowAllowed`, `repayBorrowAllowed` on the borrow side), `claimComp` and
`_setCompSpeeds`. Balance changes, the passing of blocks and COMP sent to the Comptroller are
modelled here, outside the implementation.
-/

namespace CompRewards

/-- `doubleScale` (ExponentialNoError.sol): the scale of reward index mantissas. -/
def doubleScale : Nat := 10 ^ 36

/-- `compInitialIndex` (Comptroller.sol): the value a market's reward index is set to when its
rewards are initialized. -/
def compInitialIndex : Nat := 10 ^ 36

/-- Accounts are numbered by their position in the account list. -/
abbrev Account := Nat

/-- One side (supply or borrow) of the market: reward index, the block it was last brought up
to date, and the speed in COMP per block. -/
structure Side where
  index : Nat
  block : Nat
  speed : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- One account's position and reward record. -/
structure Acct where
  supply : Nat
  borrow : Nat
  supplierIndex : Nat
  borrowerIndex : Nat
  accrued : Nat
  wallet : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An account with nothing: the record of any account number beyond the list. -/
def noAcct : Acct := ⟨0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0⟩

/-- Comptroller state for the market: current block, both sides, the Comptroller's COMP, and
the accounts. -/
structure St where
  blockNumber : Nat
  supplyState : Side
  borrowState : Side
  reserve : Nat
  accts : List Acct
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The record of account `who`. -/
def St.acct (s : St) (who : Account) : Acct := s.accts.getD who noAcct

/-- `s` with the record of account `who` changed by `f` (no change beyond the list). -/
def St.withAcct (s : St) (who : Account) (f : Acct → Acct) : St :=
  { s with accts := s.accts.modify who f }

/-- `CToken.totalSupply`: the sum of all supply balances. -/
def totalSupply (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map Acct.supply).sum

/-- Total borrow units: the sum of all borrow balances. -/
def totalBorrows (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map Acct.borrow).sum

/-- COMP held or accrued by every account: accrued and not yet paid, plus paid out. -/
def St.credited (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map fun a => a.accrued + a.wallet).sum

/-- COMP held or accrued by account `who`. -/

import CompRewards.Spec
import ProofForgeFin
/-!
Port of the COMP distribution of Compound's Comptroller as deployed by Proposal 62
(implementation 0x374ABb8cE19A73f2c4EFAd642bda76c797f19233, active on mainnet from block
13322798 to block 13382884). Source: compound-finance/compound-protocol, commit
f73b29373eb65cedf24896d7be46eed38435fc91, `contracts/Comptroller.sol`, byte-identical to the
verified source of the deployed implementation, and `contracts/ExponentialNoError.sol`.

* `updateCompSupplyIndex` (lines 1163 to 1177) and `updateCompBorrowIndex` (lines 1184 to 1198).
* `distributeSupplierComp` (lines 1205 to 1236) and `distributeBorrowerComp` (lines 1244 to 1275).
* `claimComp(holders, cTokens, true, true)` (lines 1320 to 1341) for one holder and one market,
  and `grantCompInternal` (lines 1350 to 1358).
* `setCompSpeedInternal` (lines 1130 to 1156).

The cToken's borrow index is taken as 1e18, so `div_(borrowBalanceStored, borrowIndex)` is the
account's borrow units. A `sub_` underflow or a `require` failure is `none`.
-/
namespace CompRewards

/-- `fraction(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): `Double(div_(mul_(a, doubleScale), b))`. -/
def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

/-- `mul_(uint a, Double b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): `a * b.mantissa / doubleScale`. -/
def mulDouble (a mantissa : Nat) : Nat := a * mantissa / doubleScale

/-- `sub_(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): reverts on underflow. -/
def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

/-- `updateCompSupplyIndex(cToken)`. -/
def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

/-- `updateCompBorrowIndex(cToken, marketBorrowIndex)`. -/
def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

/-- `distributeSupplierComp(cToken, supplier)`. -/
def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=

/-!
# COMP reward distribution specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the reward flywheel of Compound's Comptroller: the supply and
borrow reward indices of a market, the index recorded for each account, the COMP accrued to
each account, claims, and the one-time upgrade that Compound Proposal 62 ran on mainnet
(`_upgradeSplitCompRewards`, block 13322798, 2021-09-29). Candidates may not edit this file.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `comptroller : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`CompRewards/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole
`CompRewards.comptroller`.

Model, as a reader of `contracts/Comptroller.sol` would map it:

* One market. Its supply side and borrow side each have a reward index (`compSupplyState`,
  `compBorrowState`: `index` and `block`) and a speed in COMP per block (`compSupplySpeeds`,
  `compBorrowSpeeds`). Indices are mantissas at scale 1e36 (`doubleScale`).
* An account holds `supply` cTokens (`CToken.balanceOf`) and `borrow` borrow units (Compound's
  `borrowBalanceStored / borrowIndex`). The market's totals are the sums over all accounts.
* `supplierIndex` and `borrowerIndex` are `compSupplierIndex` and `compBorrowerIndex`; 0 means
  the Comptroller has no index recorded for the account. `accrued` is `compAccrued`, `wallet`
  is the COMP the account holds, and `reserve` is the COMP held by the Comptroller.
* Amounts are natural numbers in the smallest unit (1e-18 COMP); arithmetic is unbounded, so
  the 224-bit and 32-bit overflow checks never fail. A call that reverts is `none`.

The implementation handles the Comptroller's calls: the policy hooks a cToken calls before it
changes a balance (`mintAllowed`, `redeemAllowed`, `transferAllowed`, `seizeAllowed` on the
supply side; `borrowAllowed`, `repayBorrowAllowed` on the borrow side), `claimComp` and
`_setCompSpeeds`. Balance changes, the passing of blocks and COMP sent to the Comptroller are
modelled here, outside the implementation.
-/

namespace CompRewards

/-- `doubleScale` (ExponentialNoError.sol): the scale of reward index mantissas. -/
def doubleScale : Nat := 10 ^ 36

/-- `compInitialIndex` (Comptroller.sol): the value a market's reward index is set to when its
rewards are initialized. -/
def compInitialIndex : Nat := 10 ^ 36

/-- Accounts are numbered by their position in the account list. -/
abbrev Account := Nat

/-- One side (supply or borrow) of the market: reward index, the block it was last brought up
to date, and the speed in COMP per block. -/
structure Side where
  index : Nat
  block : Nat
  speed : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- One account's position and reward record. -/
structure Acct where
  supply : Nat
  borrow : Nat
  supplierIndex : Nat
  borrowerIndex : Nat
  accrued : Nat
  wallet : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An account with nothing: the record of any account number beyond the list. -/
def noAcct : Acct := ⟨0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0⟩

/-- Comptroller state for the market: current block, both sides, the Comptroller's COMP, and
the accounts. -/
structure St where
  blockNumber : Nat
  supplyState : Side
  borrowState : Side
  reserve : Nat
  accts : List Acct
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The record of account `who`. -/
def St.acct (s : St) (who : Account) : Acct := s.accts.getD who noAcct

/-- `s` with the record of account `who` changed by `f` (no change beyond the list). -/
def St.withAcct (s : St) (who : Account) (f : Acct → Acct) : St :=
  { s with accts := s.accts.modify who f }

/-- `CToken.totalSupply`: the sum of all supply balances. -/
def totalSupply (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map Acct.supply).sum

/-- Total borrow units: the sum of all borrow balances. -/
def totalBorrows (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map Acct.borrow).sum

/-- COMP held or accrued by every account: accrued and not yet paid, plus paid out. -/
def St.credited (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map fun a => a.accrued + a.wallet).sum

/-- COMP held or accrued by account `who`. -/
def St.credited

13322798 to block 13382884). Source: compound-finance/compound-protocol, commit

(1) Proof plan: Split `CallsSucceed` by the call. `Consistent` supplies both side-block bounds and every recorded account index bound. An update succeeds whenever its side block is not ahead of the current block, and `accrueSide` never lowers an index. After such an update, the account is unchanged and its recorded index is therefore still bounded by the updated index, so supplier/borrower distribution cannot fail in `subChecked`: the checked start is either the recorded index, `0`, or `compInitialIndex` under the guard `compInitialIndex ≤ index`. A claim is the borrow step followed by the supply step followed by the always-defined grant; speed setting is, on each side, either `some s` or the `Option.map` of a successful update, with the supply update leaving the borrow side and block number unchanged via the explicit `accrueSide` form. The lemmas below isolate exactly the account-bound extraction, index monotonicity, and the two update/distribute success facts needed for this case split.

import ProofForgeFin.DeFi.Distributor
import ProofForgeFin.DeFi.Rewards
/-!
Port of the COMP distribution of Compound's Comptroller as deployed by Proposal 62
(implementation 0x374ABb8cE19A73f2c4EFAd642bda76c797f19233, active on mainnet from block
13322798 to block 13382884). Source: compound-finance/compound-protocol, commit
f73b29373eb65cedf24896d7be46eed38435fc91, `contracts/Comptroller.sol`, byte-identical to the
verified source of the deployed implementation, and `contracts/ExponentialNoError.sol`.

* `updateCompSupplyIndex` (lines 1163 to 1177) and `updateCompBorrowIndex` (lines 1184 to 1198).
* `distributeSupplierComp` (lines 1205 to 1236) and `distributeBorrowerComp` (lines 1244 to 1275).
* `claimComp(holders, cTokens, true, true)` (lines 1320 to 1341) for one holder and one market,
  and `grantCompInternal` (lines 1350 to 1358).
* `setCompSpeedInternal` (lines 1130 to 1156).

The cToken's borrow index is taken as 1e18, so `div_(borrowBalanceStored, borrowIndex)` is the
account's borrow units. A `sub_` underflow or a `require` failure is `none`.
-/
namespace CompRewards

/-- `fraction(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): `Double(div_(mul_(a, doubleScale), b))`. -/
def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

/-- `mul_(uint a, Double b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): `a * b.mantissa / doubleScale`. -/
def mulDouble (a mantissa : Nat) : Nat := a * mantissa / doubleScale

/-- `sub_(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): reverts on underflow. -/
def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

/-- `updateCompSupplyIndex(cToken)`. -/
def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

/-- `updateCompBorrowIndex(cToken, marketBorrowIndex)`. -/
def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

/-- `distributeSupplierComp(cToken, supplier)`. -/
def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex
  match subChecked supplyIndex supplierIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

/-- `distributeBorrowerComp(cToken, borrower, marketBorrowIndex)`. -/
def distributeBorrowerComp (s : St) (borrower : Account) : Option St :=
  let borrowIndex := s.borrowState.index
  let borrowerIndex :=
    if (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ borrowIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct borrower).borrowerIndex
  match subChecked borrowIndex borrowerIndex with

verified source of the deployed implementation, and `contracts/ExponentialNoError.sol`.

* `updateCompSupplyIndex` (lines 1163 to 1177) and `updateCompBorrowIndex` (lines 1184 to 1198).
* `distributeSupplierComp` (lines 1205 to 1236) and `distributeBorrowerComp` (lines 1244 to 1275).

* `setCompSpeedInternal` (lines 1130 to 1156).

The cToken's borrow index is taken as 1e18, so `div_(borrowBalanceStored, borrowIndex)` is the
account's borrow units. A `sub_` underflow or a `require` failure is `none`.

namespace CompRewards

/-- `fraction(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): `Double(div_(mul_(a, doubleScale), b))`. -/
def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

/-- `mul_(uint a, Double b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): `a * b.mantissa / doubleScale`. -/
def mulDouble (a mantissa : Nat) : Nat := a * mantissa / doubleScale

/-- `sub_(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): reverts on underflow. -/
def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

/-- `updateCompSupplyIndex(cToken)`. -/
def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

/-- `updateCompBorrowIndex(cToken, marketBorrowIndex)`. -/
def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

/-- `distributeSupplierComp(cToken, supplier)`. -/
def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex
  match subChecked supplyIndex supplierIndex with
  | none => none
  | some deltaIndex =>
    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

namespace CompRewards

/-- `fraction(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): `Double(div_(mul_(a, doubleScale), b))`. -/
def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

/-- `sub_(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): reverts on underflow. -/
def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

/-- `updateCompSupplyIndex(cToken)`. -/
def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none

    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0

        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=

def pendSupply (s : St) (a : Acct) : Nat :=
  a.supply * (s.supplyState.index - accrualStart a.supplierIndex s.supplyState.index)
def pendBorrow (s : St) (a : Acct) : Nat :=

def sumPendBorrow (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map fun a => pendBorrow s a).sum

## Proof plan

Use `Pot` as a scaled potential: it counts credited COMP scaled by `doubleScale`, each account’s still-pending rewards, and the rewards emitted since each side’s index was last updated, also scaled. Crediting an account moves pending scaled rewards into `credited`: the integer division can only lose scaled value. Accruing an index converts unindexed emissions into pending rewards, with total pending growth bounded by the corresponding unindexed decrease. Thus every operation increases `Pot` by at most the rewards emitted during that operation. At the upgrade, account pending rewards are bounded by the legacy pending amount; crucially, `supplyStart`/`borrowStart` being `compInitialIndex` forces that value to be below the corresponding legacy index; up to one `doubleScale` division remainder. Combining the initial and run bounds with `Pot_credited_le` gives the desired unscaled bound.

borrow reward indices of a market, the index recorded for each account, the COMP accrued to
each account, claims, and the one-time upgrade that Compound Proposal 62 ran on mainnet

challenge (`CompRewards/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole

* One market. Its supply side and borrow side each have a reward index (`compSupplyState`,
  `compBorrowState`: `index` and `block`) and a speed in COMP per block (`compSupplySpeeds`,
  `compBorrowSpeeds`). Indices are mantissas at scale 1e36 (`doubleScale`).
* An account holds `supply` cTokens (`CToken.balanceOf`) and `borrow` borrow units (Compound's
  `borrowBalanceStored / borrowIndex`). The market's totals are the sums over all accounts.
* `supplierIndex` and `borrowerIndex` are `compSupplierIndex` and `compBorrowerIndex`; 0 means

* Amounts are natural numbers in the smallest unit (1e-18 COMP); arithmetic is unbounded, so
  the 224-bit and 32-bit overflow checks never fail. A call that reverts is `none`.

The implementation handles the Comptroller's calls: the policy hooks a cToken calls before it
changes a balance (`mintAllowed`, `redeemAllowed`, `transferAllowed`, `seizeAllowed` on the
supply side; `borrowAllowed`, `repayBorrowAllowed` on the borrow side), `claimComp` and

modelled here, outside the implementation.

def compInitialIndex : Nat := 10 ^ 36

abbrev Account := Nat

/-- One side (supply or borrow) of the market: reward index, the block it was last brought up

  index : Nat
  block : Nat
  speed : Nat

/-- One account's position and reward record. -/

  supply : Nat
  borrow : Nat
  supplierIndex : Nat

prose:
**Proof plan**

Split the potential of the upgraded state into credited COMP, pending supply and borrow rewards, and unindexed emission. For every legacy account, the upgraded pending reward on each side is at most the corresponding legacy scaled term: if the legacy index is positive the upgraded index is unchanged and `accrualStart` is at least `legacyStart`; if it is zero, well-formedness forces the legacy start and the account's recorded index to be zero, and initialization makes the upgraded pending term zero. Summing these pointwise bounds bounds total pending rewards by the sum defining `Legacy.pendingScaled`. Initialization also makes unindexed emission after the upgrade no larger than the legacy unindexed emission. Finally, use the division-remainder bound for the rounded-down legacy pending total and combine the pieces arithmetically in `Pot`.

prose:
(1) Proof plan: Split a supply distribution into two stages. First, `accrueSide` updates the supply index: each account’s scaled pending supply can increase by at most its supply times the index increase, while the total index increase, weighted by `totalSupply`, is bounded by the previously unindexed COMP emission; because the updated side is then at the current block, its unindexed term drops to zero, so the potential does not increase. Second, distributing to `who` transfers that account’s pending supply into `accrued`: the scaled credit is no larger than the account’s previous scaled pending supply, its new pending supply is zero, and borrow pending, other accounts, and unindexed terms are unchanged, so the potential again does not increase. Composing the two stages gives `Pot s' ≤ Pot s`.

namespace CompRewards

/-- `fraction(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): `Double(div_(mul_(a, doubleScale), b))`. -/
def fraction (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * doubleScale / b

/-- `mul_(uint a, Double b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): `a * b.mantissa / doubleScale`. -/
def mulDouble (a mantissa : Nat) : Nat := a * mantissa / doubleScale

/-- `sub_(a, b)` (ExponentialNoError.sol): reverts on underflow. -/
def subChecked (a b : Nat) : Option Nat := if b ≤ a then some (a - b) else none

/-- `updateCompSupplyIndex(cToken)`. -/
def updateCompSupplyIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.supplyState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.supplyState.speed > 0 then
      let supplyTokens := totalSupply s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.supplyState.speed
      let ratio := if supplyTokens > 0 then fraction compAccrued supplyTokens else 0
      some { s with supplyState :=
        { s.supplyState with index := s.supplyState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with supplyState := { s.supplyState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

/-- `updateCompBorrowIndex(cToken, marketBorrowIndex)`. -/
def updateCompBorrowIndex (s : St) : Option St :=
  match subChecked s.blockNumber s.borrowState.block with
  | none => none
  | some deltaBlocks =>
    if deltaBlocks > 0 ∧ s.borrowState.speed > 0 then
      let borrowAmount := totalBorrows s
      let compAccrued := deltaBlocks * s.borrowState.speed
      let ratio := if borrowAmount > 0 then fraction compAccrued borrowAmount else 0
      some { s with borrowState :=
        { s.borrowState with index := s.borrowState.index + ratio, block := s.blockNumber } }
    else if deltaBlocks > 0 then
      some { s with borrowState := { s.borrowState with block := s.blockNumber } }
    else some s

/-- `distributeSupplierComp(cToken, supplier)`. -/
def distributeSupplierComp (s : St) (supplier : Account) : Option St :=
  let supplyIndex := s.supplyState.index
  let supplierIndex :=
    if (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex = 0 ∧ compInitialIndex ≤ supplyIndex then compInitialIndex
    else (s.acct supplier).supplierIndex

    let supplierDelta := mulDouble (s.acct supplier).supply deltaIndex
    some (s.withAcct supplier fun a =>
      { a with supplierIndex := supplyIndex, accrued := a.accrued + supplierDelta })

/-!
# COMP reward distribution specification (protected)

Owner-reviewed definitions for the reward flywheel of Compound's Comptroller: the supply and
borrow reward indices of a market, the index recorded for each account, the COMP accrued to
each account, claims, and the one-time upgrade that Compound Proposal 62 ran on mainnet
(`_upgradeSplitCompRewards`, block 13322798, 2021-09-29). Candidates may not edit this file.
Every requirement is a predicate over an implementation `comptroller : Impl`; the locked
challenge (`CompRewards/Challenge.lean`) applies each one to the definition hole
`CompRewards.comptroller`.

Model, as a reader of `contracts/Comptroller.sol` would map it:

* One market. Its supply side and borrow side each have a reward index (`compSupplyState`,
  `compBorrowState`: `index` and `block`) and a speed in COMP per block (`compSupplySpeeds`,
  `compBorrowSpeeds`). Indices are mantissas at scale 1e36 (`doubleScale`).
* An account holds `supply` cTokens (`CToken.balanceOf`) and `borrow` borrow units (Compound's
  `borrowBalanceStored / borrowIndex`). The market's totals are the sums over all accounts.
* `supplierIndex` and `borrowerIndex` are `compSupplierIndex` and `compBorrowerIndex`; 0 means
  the Comptroller has no index recorded for the account. `accrued` is `compAccrued`, `wallet`
  is the COMP the account holds, and `reserve` is the COMP held by the Comptroller.
* Amounts are natural numbers in the smallest unit (1e-18 COMP); arithmetic is unbounded, so
  the 224-bit and 32-bit overflow checks never fail. A call that reverts is `none`.

The implementation handles the Comptroller's calls: the policy hooks a cToken calls before it
changes a balance (`mintAllowed`, `redeemAllowed`, `transferAllowed`, `seizeAllowed` on the
supply side; `borrowAllowed`, `repayBorrowAllowed` on the borrow side), `claimComp` and
`_setCompSpeeds`. Balance changes, the passing of blocks and COMP sent to the Comptroller are
modelled here, outside the implementation.
-/

namespace CompRewards

/-- `doubleScale` (ExponentialNoError.sol): the scale of reward index mantissas. -/
def doubleScale : Nat := 10 ^ 36

/-- `compInitialIndex` (Comptroller.sol): the value a market's reward index is set to when its
rewards are initialized. -/
def compInitialIndex : Nat := 10 ^ 36

/-- Accounts are numbered by their position in the account list. -/
abbrev Account := Nat

/-- One side (supply or borrow) of the market: reward index, the block it was last brought up
to date, and the speed in COMP per block. -/
structure Side where
  index : Nat
  block : Nat
  speed : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- One account's position and reward record. -/
structure Acct where
  supply : Nat
  borrow : Nat
  supplierIndex : Nat
  borrowerIndex : Nat
  accrued : Nat
  wallet : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- An account with nothing: the record of any account number beyond the list. -/
def noAcct : Acct := ⟨0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0⟩

/-- Comptroller state for the market: current block, both sides, the Comptroller's COMP, and
the accounts. -/
structure St where
  blockNumber : Nat
  supplyState : Side
  borrowState : Side
  reserve : Nat
  accts : List Acct
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The record of account `who`. -/
def St.acct (s : St) (who : Account) : Acct := s.accts.getD who noAcct

/-- `s` with the record of account `who` changed by `f` (no change beyond the list). -/
def St.withAcct (s : St) (who : Account) (f : Acct → Acct) : St :=
  { s with accts := s.accts.modify who f }

/-- `CToken.totalSupply`: the sum of all supply balances. -/
def totalSupply (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map Acct.supply).sum

/-- Total borrow units: the sum of all borrow balances. -/
def totalBorrows (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map Acct.borrow).sum

/-- COMP held or accrued by every account: accrued and not yet paid, plus paid out. -/
def St.credited (s : St) : Nat := (s.accts.map fun a => a.accrued + a.wallet).sum

/-- COMP held or accrued by account `who`. -/

theorem plan8_sumPendSupply_modify_borrow (s : St) (who : Account) :
    sumPendSupply { s with accts := s.accts.modify who fun a =>
      { a with
        borrowerIndex := s.borrowState.index,
        accrued := a.accrued + creditFor a.borrow
          (accrualStart a.borrowerIndex s.borrowState.index)
          s.borrowState.index } } =
      sumPendSupply s := by
  unfold sumPendSupply
  have hac : (({ s with accts := s.accts.modify who fun a =>
      ({ a with
        borrowerIndex := s.borrowState.index,
        accrued := a.accrued + creditFor a.borrow
          (accrualStart a.borrowerIndex s.borrowState.index)
          s.borrowState.index } : Acct) } : St).accts) =
      s.accts.modify who fun a =>
        ({ a with
          borrowerIndex := s.borrowState.index,
          accrued := a.accrued + creditFor a.borrow
            (accrualStart a.borrowerIndex s.borrowState.index)
            s.borrowState.index } : Acct) := rfl
  have hf : ∀ (a : Acct), pendSupply s
      ({ a with
        borrowerIndex := s.borrowState.index,
        accrued := a.accrued + creditFor a.borrow
          (accrualStart a.borrowerIndex s.borrowState.index)
          s.borrowState.index } : Acct) = pendSupply s a :=
    fun a => plan8_supply_pend_pres s a
  have hgen : ∀ (l : List Acct) (n : Nat),
      ((l.modify n fun a =>
        ({ a with
          borrowerIndex := s.borrowState.index,
          accrued := a.accrued + creditFor a.borrow
            (accrualStart a.borrowerIndex s.borrowState.index)
            s.borrowState.index } : Acct)).map fun a => pendSupply s a).sum =
      (l.map fun a => pendSupply s a).sum := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
      intro n
      rw [tmp_nil_modify_test]
    | cons hd tl ih =>
      intro n
      cases n with
      | zero =>
        rw [tmp_modify_unfold_test]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
        rw [hf hd]
      | succ n =>
        rw [tmp_modify_unfold_test2]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
        rw [ih n]
  have hsup_eq : ∀ (a : Acct),
      pendSupply { s with accts := s.accts.modify who fun b =>
        ({ b with
          borrowerIndex := s.borrowState.index,
          accrued := b.accrued + creditFor b.borrow
            (accrualStart b.borrowerIndex s.borrowState.index)
            s.borrowState.index } : Acct) } a = pendSupply s a := by
    intro a
    rfl
  have hcongr := tmp_map_sum_congr_test
    (s.accts.modify who fun a =>
      ({ a with
        borrowerIndex := s.borrowState.index,
        accrued := a.accrued + creditFor a.borrow
          (accrualStart a.borrowerIndex s.borrowState.index)
          s.borrowState.index } : Acct))
    (fun a => pendSupply { s with accts := s.accts.modify who fun b =>
        ({ b with
          borrowerIndex := s.borrowState.index,
          accrued := b.accrued + creditFor b.borrow
            (accrualStart b.borrowerIndex s.borrowState.index)
            s.borrowState.index } : Acct) } a)
    (fun a => pendSupply s a) hsup_eq
  rw [hac, hcongr]
  exact hgen s.accts who
